operations.mapping: Shared ValueCodec<T> defaults/overrides -> existing codec encoding -> C++ codec/dialect profile

operations.mapping: Typed predicates/join/aggregate expression composition -> existing query ABI -> C++ query compiler
operations.boundary: Reuse existing optional predicates, joins and aggregation; no managed SQL engine or lambda-expression interpreter.

operations.mapping: QueryCursor -> lexicographic predicate operands -> existing query ABI -> C++ dialect compiler
operations.boundary: Exact full ORDER BY sequence includes root primary key; nonnullable cursor; mixed directions; reject offset and changed ordering.

operations.mapping: Bounded parent keys -> existing relation plan -> C++ tagged UNION ALL child selections -> grouped child DTOs
operations.boundary: One query for nonempty batch; no query for empty input; preserve duplicate/input index groups and SQL equality semantics.

operations.mapping: Key/Changes/ConcurrencyCheck/returning -> existing relation ABI -> C++ provider execution
operations.boundary: Reuse existing omitted/null change set and optimistic concurrency; simplify calls only where audit demonstrates a gap.

operations.mapping: InTransactionAsync -> Begin/callback/Commit/DisposeAsync -> existing transaction ABI -> libpq/sqlite3
operations.boundary: No replay or implicit nesting; pre-cancel skips callback; unknown commit remains unknown; preserve original exception and cleanup outcome.

operations.mapping: Explicit model snapshot diff request -> compatible admin operation -> C++ dialect SQL draft -> reviewed Migration/MigrationBundle
operations.boundary: No startup migration; prior snapshot versioned; per-change destructive selection; unsupported conversions/defaults fail before apply.

operations.mapping: GetTablesAsync catalog -> explicit ambiguity hints -> C# attributed entity source -> generator compilation
operations.boundary: Do not guess missing key order/generated flags/default/type semantics; output must compile as an external consumer.

operations.mapping: Independent provider PackageReference -> provider DI -> session/Fluent -> existing diagnostics
operations.boundary: Short runnable tutorial, ordinary C# business types, redacted diagnostics, separate provider packages.
